entry: surface_scan_result(packet, cache, checkpoint, diagnostics=None, _normalize=None, _identity=None, max_new_pairs=512, _progress=None, max_delivery_bytes=524288)

packet.pairs: Every unordered directory pair once, with lower_bound_m and retained/excluded_strict_bound/unknown_source
packet.scope_issues: Known unsupported scene-scope dependencies. Nonempty prevents complete.
packet.capture: One endpoint union with surface_scan_candidates identity scope
packet.binding: Full directory complete_scene_meshes identity and same-main-thread marker

threshold: Existing exact M3 squared-distance key compared with exact binary64 threshold squared. Display floats never classify.
coverage_equation: total_pairs = bound_excluded + measured_match + measured_nonmatch + unknown + deferred
progress: One current ReadContext scan progress, keyed by current capture selection and query. No geometry copy. Successful measurement summaries survive partial continuation; normal pair cache also reused.
cache_changes: ReadContext.result opt-in cache_partial=False; SceneCache.pair_measurement optional before_compute for actual cache-miss quota charging; old defaults unchanged.
generation: Keep current generation invalidation for initial benchmark; per-object optimization deferred to administrator review.
